text:
devon: Quick question — I'm proposing a new 'cost-priority' route mode that prefers cheaper model variants for lower-tier customers and surfaces an estimated token/cost delta in the Console before rollout. Thoughts?

maria: +1. We need per-request telemetry so product/ops can validate real savings. Without cost deltas in traces it's hard to prove anything. Can we emit a header? :thinking_face:

sam: We already expose `X-Redwood-Model` and `X-Redwood-Latency-ms`. Adding `X-Redwood-Cost-Delta` (microunits or cents-per-1k-tokens) should be straightforward. Example: `X-Redwood-Cost-Delta: -0.0023`

devon: Also thinking about retries: if the cheaper variant fails quality threshold, should we auto-retry on a higher-tier model or surface an error to the app? @elen, product perspective?

elen (Product): For Dedicated/Enterprise I'd prefer an automatic canary retry (transparent to end-user) with a visible audit trail. For self-serve, default to fail-fast but show a suggestion CTA to retry on higher quality. UX idea: a 'cost vs quality' slider when enabling the policy in rollout.

frank: infra note: route decisions must be tagged so billing/quotas are coherent. If we retry on a higher-tier model we must avoid double-charging or double-deducting quota. Need idempotent billing events.

tim: ops/sre: agree with tagging. Also we should add circuit-breaker metrics: `redwood_route_retries_total`, `redwood_route_overrides_total`, `redwood_route_quality_failures_total`. We'll want Prometheus labels: tenant_id, policy, region, variant_from, variant_to.

grace: platform: Console idea — preview card that shows expected monthly savings if policy applied to X% of traffic, plus a sample of top prompts affected. Also expose a per-customer API override header: `x-rw-route-preference: cost|quality|balanced`.

sam: minor API debate: exposing this as a free-floating header may be fine, but headers are easy to misuse. Maybe prefer `route_mode` as a field in the JSON request body (SDKs set it explicitly) and allow a header only for advanced/edge cases.

telemetry-bot: quick sketch of a proposed routing config payload for internal config/pr:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "cost_priority_v1",
  "target_customer_tiers": ["starter","standard"],
  "variants_preference": ["rw-small-8q","rw-medium-8q","rw-large-16q"],
  "quality_threshold": 0.85,
  "retry_on_quality_fail": true,
  "retry_priority": "latency",
  "max_retries": 1
}
```

devon: Implementation concerns: runtime needs per-tenant token budget signals to decide when to degrade, and it must check quota service before downgrading. Cheaper variant sometimes expands token usage (longer responses) — we need estimated token multipliers in the cost calc.

frank: infra follow-up: we'll add `estimated_tokens_multiplier` into the cost estimator and a migration-safe feature flag `cost_path_rolling`. We'll also ensure billing emits `billing_model_served` event with correlation id to the original request.

tim: SLO guardrails: require canary at 0.5-1% for 24h, with an automated rollback if QoR regressions exceed 2% (or absolute error spike). Add an alert playbook.

elen (Product): UX follow-ups: when a rollback occurs, Console should show sample prompts that regressed with side-by-side outputs and a human-readable diff view so PMs can approve/abort automatically.

maria: quick question about billing/legal: do we bill for the served model or the requested model? that changes customer-facing docs. @nina can you weigh in?

nina (Finance): We currently bill based on the served model in practice. If we change routing default behavior we need to update the TOS and billing docs and notify customers. For self-serve, default billing-by-served-model is fine; for enterprise we can negotiate contract-level rules.

devon: ok. Action items: spec API shape (sam), telemetry metrics & headers (maria + tim), infra changes & billing events (frank + nina), Console savings card & rollback UI (grace + elen). I'll open a tracking PR and tag owners.

ops-bot: Created ticket RWI-4821: "implement cost-priority routing mode" and assigned devon, sam, grace, frank, tim.

grace: on it :thumbsup:

sam: I'll draft API spec by EOD and include request-body sample + header compatibility notes.

frank: infra plan by Tue morning.

tim: I'll add the alert rules and runbook to SRE docs.

devon: thanks everyone — let's aim for a canary in staging next week.

maria: tiny nit — make sure Console estimates are conservative (pessimistic) to avoid surprising customers.

devon: noted. Closing thread for now, will follow up in PR. Thanks! :raised_hands:
